verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own AI Assistant inside the Dashboard. It generates SQL from your specifications, analyzes SQL errors and suggests fixes, and gives recommendations tailored to the table you are working on. Those are genuine in-product AI suggestions, but the evidence frames them around schema design and SQL authoring rather than insights drawn from the data itself. Advisors are deterministic checks rather than AI, and MCP serves external agents, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: documented AI analysis that surfaces insights, trends or summaries from the actual stored data; independent or hands-on corroboration of the Assistant's suggestion quality.
